vision: AI-powered LinkedIn banner designer that creates stunning, professional banners in seconds with voice-powered workflows

target_audience.primary: Career-focused professionals seeking to enhance their LinkedIn presence through visually compelling banners
secondary: Career coaches creating branded materials for clients
Marketing professionals managing personal or company brands
Job seekers wanting to stand out with professional profiles
HR professionals and recruiters building employer brand
Personal brand consultants creating assets for clients
Content creators building thought leadership presence

milestones.title: Technical Debt Resolved

milestones.title: LinkedIn Preview Excellence
milestones.description: Users can see exactly how their banner will appear on LinkedIn desktop and mobile

milestones.title: Reliable AI Experience
milestones.description: AI operations are predictable with proper fallbacks and error handling

phases.name: User Experience Enhancement
phases.description: Improve usability, add quality-of-life features, and address competitor weaknesses

milestones.title: Template Excellence
milestones.description: Professional, LinkedIn-optimized templates that stand out from generic competitors

milestones.title: Workflow Efficiency
milestones.description: Streamlined workflows that address competitor UI friction complaints

milestones.title: Brand Intelligence
milestones.description: Smart brand consistency features that competitors lack

phases.name: Scale & Growth
phases.description: Team features, integrations, and capabilities for professional/enterprise users

milestones.title: LinkedIn Integration Live
milestones.description: Direct publishing to LinkedIn eliminates manual upload friction

milestones.title: Team Collaboration
milestones.description: Career coaches and agencies can work with clients seamlessly

milestones.title: Productivity at Scale
milestones.description: Batch processing and analytics for power users

phases.name: Platform Expansion
phases.description: Mobile experience, offline capabilities, and advanced AI features

milestones.title: Mobile-First Design
milestones.description: Full mobile-responsive editor addressing competitor mobile failures

milestones.title: Offline Resilience
milestones.description: PWA capabilities ensuring work is never lost - unlike Canva outages

milestones.title: AI Innovation
milestones.description: Next-generation AI features that extend the voice-first advantage

features.title: Proper Admin Authentication System
features.description: Replace the current existence check with a proper useAdminAuth hook pattern for secure and maintainable admin authentication. This addresses a known technical debt item.
features.rationale: Current admin check uses an existence check instead of a proper authentication hook. This is a security and maintainability concern that should be resolved before scaling.
acceptance_criteria: useAdminAuth hook created and implemented
All admin routes use the new hook for authentication
Existing admin functionality continues to work
Unit tests cover authentication scenarios
user_stories: As an admin, I want secure authentication so that unauthorized users cannot access admin features

features.title: ChatInterface Phase 2 Migration
features.description: Export and migrate ChatInterface Phase 2 components from the Phase 1 structure. Improve profile updates handling with better state management in chat context.
features.rationale: Known gap from discovery - ChatInterface Phase 2 components need to be exported, and profile updates handling in chat is incomplete. This affects the brainstorm tab experience.
acceptance_criteria: All ChatInterface Phase 2 components are properly exported
Profile updates are handled correctly in chat context
State management is clean and predictable
Brainstorm tab functions without errors
user_stories: As a user, I want the brainstorm chat to remember my profile preferences so that suggestions are personalized

features.title: LinkedIn Desktop/Mobile Preview Mode
features.description: Add a preview mode that shows exactly how the banner will appear on LinkedIn's desktop and mobile views, including profile picture overlay, headline text, and company info placement.
features.rationale: Addresses major competitor pain point (pain-1-7) - even dedicated LinkedIn templates in Canva result in cropping issues. This is a core differentiator opportunity addressing gap-2.
acceptance_criteria: Preview toggle shows desktop LinkedIn profile view
Preview toggle shows mobile LinkedIn profile view
Profile picture overlay is accurately positioned
Safe zones are visually highlighted
Users can see text legibility in context
user_stories: As a professional, I want to see exactly how my banner will look on LinkedIn so that I don't have cropping surprises after uploading

features.title: Enhanced Safe Zone Visualization
features.description: Improve the existing safe zone feature with visual warnings when elements are placed in dangerous areas, and auto-snap suggestions to keep important content visible.
features.rationale: LinkedIn banner dimension issues are a universal competitor pain point. Enhanced safe zones directly address the gap-2 opportunity and strengthen our LinkedIn-specific optimization.
acceptance_criteria: Visual warning appears when elements enter danger zones
Suggestion to move elements to safe areas
Auto-snap option to nearest safe position
Different warnings for desktop vs mobile visibility
user_stories: As a user, I want warnings when I place text in areas that might be cut off so that my banner looks professional on all devices

features.title: AI Model Fallback System
features.description: Implement intelligent fallback between AI providers when primary model fails. If Gemini is unavailable, route to OpenRouter alternatives. Includes retry logic and user notification.
features.rationale: Competitors like Visme have 47% AI failure rates (pain-4-2). Our multi-model architecture is a key differentiator (gap-3), but we need robust fallback to deliver on the reliability promise.
acceptance_criteria: Primary model failure triggers fallback to secondary
User is notified when fallback is used
Fallback maintains similar output quality
Retry logic with exponential backoff
Metrics track fallback usage for monitoring
user_stories: As a user, I want my banner generation to complete even if one AI service is down so that I'm not blocked by external issues

features.title: Voice Error Diagnostics Consolidation
features.description: Consolidate voice error diagnostics utilities and improve error messaging for the voice agent. Provide clear, actionable error messages when voice commands fail.
features.rationale: Voice-first design is our unique differentiator (gap-1). Ensuring reliable voice experience with clear error handling is essential. This also addresses technical debt identified in discovery.
acceptance_criteria: Voice error utilities consolidated into single module
Error messages are user-friendly and actionable
Common issues have specific troubleshooting guidance
Browser compatibility warnings are clear
user_stories: As a user, I want clear error messages when voice commands fail so that I know how to fix the issue

features.title: Professional Template Library Expansion
features.description: Expand the template library from 20+ to 50+ LinkedIn-specific templates organized by industry/role. All templates optimized for safe zones and mobile/desktop viewing.
features.rationale: Canva locks premium templates behind paywall (pain-1-3), leading to generic-looking banners. By offering more professional, LinkedIn-specific templates, we differentiate from generic tools.
acceptance_criteria: 50+ templates available
Templates organized by industry (Tech, Finance, Marketing, etc.)
Templates organized by role (Executive, Manager, Individual Contributor)
All templates validated against safe zones
Templates showcase varied visual styles
user_stories: As a marketing professional, I want templates designed for my industry so that my banner looks appropriate for my field

features.title: Template Customization Presets
features.description: Allow users to save customized templates as personal presets. Includes color scheme extraction from uploaded images and brand profile auto-application.
features.rationale: Addresses the 'generic templates don't reflect unique personal brand' pain point. Enables quick A/B testing of designs - a key user goal from discovery.
acceptance_criteria: Users can save current design as personal preset
Presets can be loaded and modified
Brand profile colors auto-apply to presets
Color extraction from uploaded images works
user_stories: As a content creator, I want to save my banner style as a preset so that I can quickly create consistent variations for A/B testing

features.title: Quick Action Toolbar
features.description: Implement a contextual quick action toolbar that appears based on selected element. Reduces clicks required for common operations like color change, font selection, and layer ordering.
features.rationale: Adobe Express (pain-2-2) and Figma (pain-3-3) received massive backlash for UI changes requiring more clicks. Our toolbar should prioritize speed and minimize clicks.
acceptance_criteria: Toolbar appears on element selection
Common actions accessible in 1 click
Toolbar position is context-aware (doesn't overlap content)
Keyboard shortcuts displayed on hover
user_stories: As a user, I want quick access to common actions so that I can edit efficiently without hunting through menus

features.title: Keyboard Shortcuts Enhancement
features.description: Expand keyboard shortcuts to cover all common operations. Include a shortcuts cheat sheet overlay (triggered by '?') and customizable shortcut bindings.
features.rationale: Power users frustrated with competitor UI changes (pain-3-3). Keyboard shortcuts provide workflow efficiency that can't be taken away by UI redesigns.
acceptance_criteria: All common operations have keyboard shortcuts
Press '?' to show shortcuts overlay
Shortcuts displayed in toolbar tooltips
Shortcuts work consistently across all tabs
user_stories: As a power user, I want comprehensive keyboard shortcuts so that I can work faster without using the mouse

features.title: Smart Brand Consistency Checker
features.description: Add a 'Brand Check' feature that analyzes the current design against the user's brand profile and suggests corrections for color deviations, font mismatches, or style inconsistencies.
features.rationale: No competitor has a brand consistency engine that automatically enforces guidelines (gap-8). This addresses the user goal of maintaining brand consistency.
acceptance_criteria: Brand Check button triggers analysis
Report shows deviations from brand profile
One-click fix suggestions for each deviation
Severity levels (minor, moderate, major)
Option to mark deviations as intentional
user_stories: As a career coach, I want to ensure my client banners match their brand guidelines so that their visual identity is consistent

features.title: Enhanced Brand Profile Extraction
features.description: Improve the brand profile extraction to analyze LinkedIn profiles, personal websites, and uploaded brand materials. Extract colors, fonts, tone, and style preferences automatically.
features.rationale: Visme's Brand Wizard has 89% satisfaction for similar functionality. By enhancing our brand extraction, we compete with their strength while adding more sources.
acceptance_criteria: Extract colors from uploaded images/PDFs
Parse LinkedIn profile for tone analysis
Extract brand elements from provided URLs
AI suggests brand keywords and style
User can refine extracted profile
user_stories: As a professional, I want Nanobanna to understand my brand from my LinkedIn profile so that generated banners match my style automatically

features.title: LinkedIn OAuth Integration & Direct Publishing
features.description: Implement LinkedIn OAuth to enable direct banner publishing to user profiles. Include preview of how banner will appear post-publish and scheduling for optimal timing.
features.rationale: Known gap from discovery - eliminates the manual upload step entirely. Addresses user goal of quick updates and reduces friction to zero.
acceptance_criteria: LinkedIn OAuth flow implemented
User can connect LinkedIn account
One-click publish to LinkedIn profile
Preview shows post-publish appearance
Publish history tracked in gallery
user_stories: As a job seeker, I want to publish my banner directly to LinkedIn so that I don't have to manually download and upload

features.title: Team Workspace & Collaboration
features.description: Create team workspaces where career coaches or agencies can collaborate with clients. Includes shared brand profiles, design comments, and approval workflows.
features.rationale: Known gap from discovery. Target audience includes career coaches and personal brand consultants who need to work with multiple clients.
acceptance_criteria: Teams can be created with invite links
Team members see shared designs
Comments can be added to designs
Approval workflow (draft → review → approved)
Team admin can manage members
user_stories: As a career coach, I want to share design drafts with my clients so that they can approve before I finalize

features.title: Design Sharing & Public Links
features.description: Enable users to create shareable links for designs. Links can be view-only or allow comments. Useful for getting feedback from colleagues or clients.
features.rationale: Complements team collaboration but serves individual users who need quick feedback. Existing sharedLinks table suggests this was planned.
acceptance_criteria: Generate shareable link for any design
Configure link permissions (view/comment)
Set link expiration if desired
Track who viewed shared links
Revoke links at any time
user_stories: As a professional, I want to share my banner draft with a colleague so that I can get quick feedback before publishing

features.title: Batch Banner Generation
features.description: Generate multiple banner variations from a single prompt with different styles, colors, or layouts. Ideal for A/B testing or generating options quickly.
features.rationale: Known gap from discovery. Addresses user goal of quickly A/B testing different banner designs. Power user feature for efficiency.
acceptance_criteria: Generate 3-5 variations from single prompt
Each variation has different style/color scheme
All variations saved to gallery
Comparison view for selecting best option
Usage metrics tracked for each generation
user_stories: As a marketing professional, I want to generate multiple banner options quickly so that I can compare and choose the best one

features.title: User Analytics Dashboard
features.description: Provide users with analytics on their design activity: generation history, processing times, credit usage, most-used features, and export history.
features.rationale: Known gap from discovery - advanced analytics dashboard. Helps users understand their usage and plan accordingly. Supports BYOK users managing costs.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows generation history
Credit/API usage visualized over time
Export history with download links
Most-used features highlighted
Cost estimation for BYOK users
user_stories: As a BYOK user, I want to see my API usage so that I can manage my costs effectively

features.title: Test Coverage Expansion
features.description: Expand test coverage for newer features including voice agent, AI services, and canvas operations. Target 80% coverage for critical paths.
features.rationale: Technical debt from discovery - test coverage needs expansion. Essential for reliability, especially as we add more features.
acceptance_criteria: Voice agent commands have unit tests
AI service calls are properly mocked and tested
Canvas operations have integration tests
Critical user flows have E2E tests
Coverage reports generated in CI
user_stories: As a developer, I want comprehensive test coverage so that I can confidently make changes without breaking existing functionality

features.title: Mobile-Responsive Design Editor
features.description: Create a fully responsive design editor that works well on tablets and large phones. Touch-optimized controls, gesture support, and mobile-specific UI patterns.
features.rationale: Known gap from discovery. Multiple competitors have terrible mobile experiences (pain-1-2, pain-5-3). Major opportunity to capture mobile users frustrated with Canva.
acceptance_criteria: Editor works on tablets (iPad, Android tablets)
Touch gestures for pan, zoom, rotate
Mobile-optimized toolbar placement
Text input works reliably on mobile
Performance acceptable on mid-range devices
user_stories: As a professional on the go, I want to edit my banner on my tablet so that I can make quick updates anywhere

features.title: PWA & Offline Mode
features.description: Convert Nanobanna Pro to a Progressive Web App with offline capabilities. Cache designs locally, queue operations for when online, and enable install-to-home-screen.
features.rationale: Known gap from discovery. Canva had 3 major outages in late 2025 (pain-1-5). PWA ensures users can continue working even during service disruptions.
acceptance_criteria: App installable on desktop and mobile
Designs cached locally for offline viewing
Edits queued when offline, synced when online
Clear offline indicator in UI
Graceful degradation of AI features when offline
user_stories: As a user, I want my designs saved locally so that I never lose work due to connection issues or service outages

features.title: Voice Command Recording & Playback
features.description: Allow users to record sequences of voice commands as macros. Replay macros to automate repetitive design workflows.
features.rationale: Extends voice-first differentiator (gap-1). Power users can create custom automation without coding. No competitor has anything similar.
acceptance_criteria: Start/stop recording of voice commands
Recorded macros saved with name
Macros can be replayed with one click
Variables supported in macros (e.g., 'use [current brand colors]')
Macros editable after recording
user_stories: As a power user, I want to record my voice workflow so that I can repeat it for future banners

features.title: AI Style Learning
features.description: Implement AI that learns from user's design preferences and past choices. Over time, AI suggestions become more personalized to user's aesthetic.
features.rationale: Competitors like Adobe Express are criticized for AI that takes over (pain-2-3). Our AI should help without imposing, learning user preferences.
acceptance_criteria: AI tracks user's color choices over time
AI learns preferred layouts and styles
Suggestions weighted by personal preferences
User can reset or adjust learned preferences
Privacy-respecting local learning preferred
user_stories: As a repeat user, I want Nanobanna to learn my style preferences so that suggestions match my taste over time

features.title: Multi-Platform Banner Export
features.description: Extend beyond LinkedIn to generate banners optimized for other platforms: Twitter/X headers, Facebook covers, YouTube channel art, all from a single design.
features.rationale: Future market expansion opportunity. Many professionals maintain multiple platform presences. Extends the brand consistency value proposition.
acceptance_criteria: Export design to Twitter/X header dimensions
Export to Facebook cover dimensions
Export to YouTube channel art dimensions
AI intelligently adjusts layout for each platform
Maintain brand consistency across platforms
user_stories: As a content creator, I want consistent branding across all my social platforms so that my presence is recognizable everywhere
